description: This file declares the LocalRecorder class used for recording or managing video display streams within the WebRTC streaming context, including methods for creation, adding displays, and stopping recording, along with internal implementation details.

classes.name: LocalRecorder
classes.description: A class responsible for recording or managing video streams, providing methods to create instances, add display streams, and stop recording.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new LocalRecorder instance with a specified filename.

methods.name: AddDisplay
methods.description: Adds a display stream with a name, dimensions, and a video source to the recorder.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the recording or streaming process.
